home.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
home.faq.a1: autoace-cli is the open-source bridge between an MCP AI client and the Kuaiyou Master App. It inspects the screen, validates skills, and sends them to the phone after you confirm.
home.faq.q2: Which AI tools do the docs cover?
home.faq.a2: The docs currently cover Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and generic MCP client configuration. Other MCP-compatible clients may work, but should be verified against their specific version.
home.faq.q3: Is root access required to run automation tasks?
home.faq.a3: No root is required. Kuaiyou Master uses Android Accessibility Services to execute actions; you still grant the required permissions and confirm before importing or running a skill.
home.faq.q4: Must AI stay connected while a skill runs?
home.faq.a4: No. AI helps inspect the screen and create the skill. After delivery and confirmation, Kuaiyou Master runs it on the phone. Reconnect only when you need changes.

docs.quickstart.title: Quick Start: from zero to your first skill
docs.quickstart.lead: No tool tables to memorize, no JSON to hand-write. Walk through the 3 steps and the AI sees your screen, writes the skill, validates it, and pushes it — you only confirm on the phone.
docs.quickstart.prep.title: What you need
docs.quickstart.prep.1: Kuaiyou Master app installed on your phone
docs.quickstart.prep.2: An AI agent client installed on your computer (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, or similar)
docs.quickstart.prep.3: Phone and computer on the same LAN (same Wi-Fi)
docs.quickstart.phone.title: Step 2 · Open the Kuaiyou Master app
docs.quickstart.phone.1: In the Kuaiyou Master app: Settings → Advanced → MCP Service, enable it.
docs.quickstart.phone.2: Tap the MCP Service entry → Copy for Agent, then paste the whole text into the AI chat and send it.
docs.quickstart.computer.title: Step 1 · Send this prompt to the AI
docs.quickstart.computer.desc: Copy the whole prompt into your AI client:
docs.quickstart.computer.what: The AI installs autoace-cli, adds the autoace Agent Skill, and configures MCP. It will tell you when it needs your help.
docs.quickstart.first.title: Step 3 · Your first skill: tap the Confirm button
docs.quickstart.first.desc: Send this prompt to the AI (main example: tap Confirm whenever it appears, up to 3 times):
docs.quickstart.first.what: The AI follows "see screen → write skill → validate → push". A confirmation appears on the phone — tap Confirm/Allow and the skill runs locally. The AI waits and reports the log.

docs.tutorial.pick.lead: For each client, only the place you click and one copy-paste config. After installing MCP, always reload or start a new chat and confirm pair_device shows up before continuing.

docs.tutorial.pick.codex.steps: Click: append the config below to ~/.codex/config.toml, restart Codex, start a new session and confirm pair_device appears in tools.
docs.tutorial.pick.generic.title: Any MCP client
docs.tutorial.pick.generic.steps: This template works for any MCP-capable client. With autoace-cli installed globally, set command to autoace-cli and drop args. env is always optional (see below).
docs.tutorial.pick.common.title: Same for every client
docs.tutorial.pick.common.1: Do not run the stdio server in a plain foreground terminal — the AI client launches it and it exits when done.
docs.tutorial.pick.common.2: env is optional: pair_device writes ~/.config/autoace/device.json locally on success.
docs.tutorial.pick.common.3: If the session tool catalog is missing a tool that CLI tools/list already has: start a new chat, do not conclude the CLI lacks it.
docs.tutorial.pick.common.4: "MCP connected" does not mean the phone is still connected: when it drops, re-copy the full "Copy to Agent" text and pair_device again.

docs.tutorial.workflow.title: Default workflow
docs.tutorial.workflow.lead: One main line; every scenario is a variation of it:
docs.tutorial.workflow.step.1: pair_device: paste the full "Copy to Agent" text to pair and write the local device.json.
docs.tutorial.workflow.step.2: observe_screen: read the current screen and interactive nodes (the default first step; use get_ui_tree only for the full tree).
docs.tutorial.workflow.step.3: get_kuaiyou_prompts / get_kuaiyou_schema: author skills against the current App contract.
docs.tutorial.workflow.step.4: validate_kuaiyou_skill: push only after validation passes.
docs.tutorial.workflow.step.5: push_reactive_skill (run: true): deploy to the phone, run locally after confirmation, read the returned log.
docs.tutorial.workflow.plans: plans_schema / plans_validate / plans_deploy / plans_list / plans_get are used only when you explicitly ask for a "domain coach / learning plan"; the default flow never touches them.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.title: Scenarios and tutorials
docs.tutorial.scenarios.lead: One card per scenario: copy the whole prompt to your AI. The main path is the step sequence your agent should follow.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.1.scene: Open WeChat and wait for the home screen
docs.tutorial.scenarios.1.prompt: First confirm autoace is connected, then observe_screen to look at my phone. Write a skill that opens WeChat and waits until the home screen appears (for example, the "Discover" or "Contacts" tab is visible). Validate with validate_kuaiyou_skill, then push_reactive_skill (run: true) and send me the log when done.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.1.path: pair_device → observe_screen → write skill (tap WeChat icon → wait for home text) → validate → push run:true
docs.tutorial.scenarios.1.note: Write selectors from the actual observe_screen output, never guess widget IDs; if unsure what marks the home screen, open WeChat once manually and observe again.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.2.scene: Open Alipay and wait for the home screen
docs.tutorial.scenarios.2.prompt: observe_screen to look at the current screen, then write a skill that opens Alipay and waits until the home screen appears (for example, the bottom "Home" tab is visible). If an agreement or teen-mode popup appears, dismiss it first and continue. Validate, then push (run: true).
docs.tutorial.scenarios.2.path: pair_device → observe_screen → write skill (tap icon → dismiss popups → wait for home) → validate → push run:true
docs.tutorial.scenarios.2.note: Popup wording varies by version; rely on what observe_screen shows; only reference text that actually exists on the current screen.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.3.prompt: observe_screen to look at the current popup. Write a skill that dismisses popups like "Not now", "Later", "Cancel", or "Got it" when they appear, up to 3 times, then stop and describe the screen. Validate, then push (run: true).
docs.tutorial.scenarios.3.path: observe_screen → write skill (tap dismiss on popup, maxExecutions 3) → validate → push run:true
docs.tutorial.scenarios.3.note: Use only real text from observe_screen; no fixed coordinates; stop after handling popups, never loop.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.4.prompt: observe_screen to look at the current screen. Write a skill that taps "Check-in" once when the text appears and ends — no other actions. Validate, then push (run: true).
docs.tutorial.scenarios.4.path: observe_screen → write skill (tap when "Check-in" visible, maxExecutions 1) → validate → push run:true
docs.tutorial.scenarios.4.note: One tap and stop; decline any "check in every day" infinite-loop requests.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.5.scene: Smoke test: open a page and assert text
docs.tutorial.scenarios.5.prompt: Run a smoke test: open the Settings page and confirm the text "About phone" appears. observe_screen and write selectors against the real screen, validate, then push (run: true) and tell me whether it passed.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.5.path: observe_screen → write skill (open target page → wait for asserted text) → validate → push run:true → report from log
docs.tutorial.scenarios.5.note: Assert by text, not coordinates; one pass and stop, no automatic retry loops.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.6.scene: Missed tap: fix selector from log, re-push
docs.tutorial.scenarios.6.prompt: The tap missed. Using the returned log and screenshot, compare against observe_screen on the current screen, fix the target selector, validate_kuaiyou_skill, then push_reactive_skill (run: true) again.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.6.path: read last log / screenshot → observe_screen → fix target selector → validate → push run:true
docs.tutorial.scenarios.6.note: Fix the target, not a coordinate offset; always validate before pushing again.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.7.prompt: I changed networks. Here is the new full "Copy to Agent" text: <paste it>. Please pair_device again before continuing.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.7.path: pair_device (new connection info) → observe_screen → continue the original task
docs.tutorial.scenarios.7.note: No mcp.json / env changes needed; pair_device updates the local device.json; the port changes every time the MCP service starts.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.8.body: Used only when you explicitly say "learning plan / domain coach": plans_schema → author a LearningPlan → plans_validate → plans_deploy (returns pendingConfirm=true; it takes effect only after you confirm on the phone) → plans_list / plans_get to check progress. Never propose a learning plan unprompted; it is a completely different category from skills.
docs.tutorial.scenarios.forbidden: Not covered: grinding / infinite loops, Toutiao regression fixtures, endless Douyin swipes, test_* compatibility suites, developer-mode skip-confirmation, or ADB. Every example caps maxExecutions and stops when done.
docs.tutorial.recovery.title: Common issues
docs.tutorial.recovery.lead: When something goes wrong, copy the matching line to your AI:
docs.tutorial.recovery.1.case: pair_device missing from the tool list
docs.tutorial.recovery.1.prompt: pair_device is missing from my tool list, but autoace-cli is installed via npm. Please follow the reload steps for my client from AI Agent setup above (Cursor: Disable→Enable; Claude Code: restart the session; Codex: restart), then start a new chat and run pair_device.
docs.tutorial.recovery.2.prompt: The device is disconnected. Ask me to reopen the MCP service in Kuaiyou Master and send you the full "Copy to Agent" text, then pair_device again.
docs.tutorial.recovery.3.prompt: The tap missed. Fix the selector using the returned log and screenshot, validate_kuaiyou_skill, then push_reactive_skill (run: true).
docs.tutorial.recovery.4.prompt: observe_screen is missing from this session but CLI tools/list has it. That is a session cache issue — start a new chat, do not conclude the CLI is missing the tool.
docs.intro.title: autoace docs
docs.intro.p1: Paste the install prompt into an AI Agent to set up the CLI, Skill, and MCP. Then write Android on-device automation skills with AI, validate, and push them to Kuaiyou Master for local execution.
docs.app.title: Get the Kuaiyou Master Android App
docs.app.p: Kuaiyou Master is the required phone runtime. It reads the screen and runs a skill locally after you confirm. Use the official product page to choose an app-store channel for your device.
docs.app.note: Follow the App setup to grant only the required permissions. The Agent install flow will also guide you to enable MCP Service. Do not install unknown APKs from unofficial sources.
docs.agentInstall.prompt.text: Install the Kuaiyou Master CLI and Agent Skill, and configure MCP: https://kuaiyou-app.github.io/autoace-cli-installation-guide.md
docs.install.title: Install autoace-cli manually
docs.install.p: After installing the MCP CLI, still wire it into your AI client's MCP config.
docs.install.req.2: Access to the npm registry (or a working mirror)
docs.install.tip: This is an MCP stdio server. Let your AI client launch it. env is optional; a successful pair_device writes ~/.config/autoace/device.json.
docs.agent.title: Install Agent Skill manually: autoace
docs.agent.p: Install the full skill package (with reference docs). Lands in the Skills directory of your current client.
docs.write.prompt.sample: Use autoace MCP: first observe_screen to inspect my phone screen, then write a skill that taps the Confirm button whenever it appears, up to 3 times with about 2s between taps. Validate with validate_kuaiyou_skill, then push_reactive_skill with run: true and wait until it finishes. Do not use removed readText / setClipboard — use storeValue for read/write.
